cis_text.title: Train Workforce on How to Identify and Report if Their Enterprise Assets are Missing Security Updates

ai_guidance.llm: Educate staff on the importance of keeping AI tools and local environments updated and how to report issues. Ensures that vulnerabilities in decentralized AI tools, such as local LLM runners, are identified and addressed promptly, reducing the attack surface.
ai_guidance.agent: Train staff to recognize agent drift or tool failure as potential security indicators, not just bugs. An agent failing to use a safety tool or bypassing a guardrail may indicate a compromised runtime. In autonomous systems, a missing update isn’t just an unpatched OS, it’s an agent running an outdated system prompt or deprecated tool definition that lacks current safety constraints, leaving it vulnerable to known jailbreaks.
ai_guidance.mcp: Train teams operating MCP servers, gateways, and clients to recognize and report pending security updates to MCP SDKs, JSON-RPC libraries, OAuth libraries, and server runtimes. MCP SDK updates can silently change authorization semantics, fix token validation behavior, or patch capability negotiation logic without obvious external symptoms; personnel who do not know to monitor MCP-specific advisories will run vulnerable components indefinitely.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
Claims use ATT&CK Enterprise 16.1, the version that the source mapping uses. See later_version for changes in newer versions.
CIS claims (cis_claims and cis/safeguards) use ATT&CK Enterprise 19.1, the version that the CIS mapping uses.

ATLAS results describe the ATLAS release in versions.atlas, pinned by commit and digest. ATLAS changes often: a later release can add techniques and mitigations. An empty mitigation list means that this release links no mitigation, not that no mitigation exists. agent_related is derived by this project from names.
